claims.text: The Seattle Waterfront is a short walk from the hotel.

findings.quote: Situated just a short walk from W Seattle, the Seattle Waterfront is a beautiful expanse of parks, piers, and promenades

claims.text: Each 14th-floor mural is a unique portrait representing one of Seattle's neighborhoods.

findings.quote: Each has a unique portrait of a person representing each of Seattle’s vibrant neighborhoods.

claims.text: Rooms draw inspiration from the Pacific Northwest and feature city views, Davines bath amenities and a W signature pillowtop bed.

findings.quote: Our 424 hotel rooms and suites draw inspiration from the Pacific Northwest, and feature city views, Davines bath amenities and a W signature pillowtop bed.

claims.text: The Penthouse suite is 24 floors up, with a master bedroom, walk-in closet and living and dining space.

findings.quote: Elevate your stay 24 floors up in our 1,000 square foot Penthouse hotel suite in downtown Seattle, complete with expansive views, spacious master bedroom and bathroom, walk in closet and unique living room and dining space.

claims.text: The Living Room bar has live DJs and bands on weekends and handcrafted cocktails daily.

findings.quote: Our cocktail bar in downtown Seattle features live DJs and bands on the weekends, monthly events, and handcrafted cocktails and bites daily.
Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of the W Living Room

claims.text: TRACE Market serves Pacific Northwest food for dine-in, take-out or grab-and-go.

findings.quote: An artisanal, fast, local and planet-friendly food mecca serving a regional bounty of the Pacific Northwest
Dine-in, take-out or grab-and-go, TRACE Market caters to the modern guest and business traveler.

claims.text: Aescape robotic massage is available on site.

findings.quote: Yes, Aescape Robotic Massage is located on-site at W Seattle.

claims.text: The FIT gym has Life Fitness cardio and strength equipment.

findings.quote: Featuring state-of-the-art Life Fitness cardio and strength training equipment, the FIT gym

claims.text: Up to two pets of any size are welcome per room.

findings.quote: Up to 2 pets per room of all sizes and weights are welcome.

claims.text: Every guest room on the 14th floor has an original hand-painted mural by resident artist Morgan Zion.

findings.quote: Located on the 14th floor, all guest rooms are home to an original hand-painted mural by resident artist Morgan Zion.

claims.text: The W Sound Suite is a full recording studio with views of Mt. Rainier.

findings.quote: W Seattle’s Sound Suite is a full recording studio, complete with views of Mt. Rainier.

claims.text: The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange things like Seattle Opera seats, a personal shopper at the Nordstrom flagship or a seaplane ride over Lake Union.

findings.quote: Whether you want seats at the Seattle Opera, a personal shopper at the Nordstrom flagship store, a romantic seaplane ride over Lake Union, or bottles of bubbly, you got it.
At W Seattle, your wish is our command with our Whatever/Whenever® service.

claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Seattle, steps from attractions such as Pike Place Market.

findings.quote: Centrally located in the heart of downtown, our Seattle hotel near the waterfront is just steps away from famous attractions such as Pike Place Market
Our accommodations feature floor-to-ceiling windows, ample space and high-speed internet access.

claims.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.

findings.quote: No, rooms at W Seattle do not have a fridge.
